name: Reelz
tagline: Turns photos and clips into vertical reels, with publishing left entirely to you
description: Feed it a pile of pictures and short clips and it cuts them into vertical videos sized for the big short-form apps. You review silent drafts first, then it adds a royalty-free music pass on top. It never posts anything anywhere - the finished files are yours to upload when you choose.
author: Orgonix23
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
